newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Friday as the yen's gains against the dollar offset a stronger Chicago market overnight, traders said.
Prices ranged from 60 yen lower to 240 yen higher, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 60 yen at 13,730 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 40,758 lots.

Market participants sold in early morning, discouraged by the yen's gains against the dollar, traders said. "Technical buying emerged later, and some contracts recovered by the closing. But investors basically could not find clear direction today," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.72 per bushel at 0750 GMT, against $2.72-1/2 at Thursday's close.
The spot January contract of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was traded at $7.06-1/4 per bushel at 0750 GMT, against $7.06 at Thursday's close.
